worker.outcomeSummary: Finished applyEventStream in src/reducer.ts (committed in this worktree). It now validates the entire delivered delivery before touching anything — every event must be a non-null object with a non-empty string id, a non-negative integer seq and an op of SET/PUT/DELETE, and no position may be claimed by two different events — then replays the steps in ascending seq order rather than delivery order, so reordered, truncated or re-delivered arrays still yield the log's state, while a rejected history leaves the caller's state object untouched and in-place updates are returned to the caller.
